scientific_truth: Warm water can help break down food faster and improve digestion by increasing blood flow to the digestive tract and altering gut motility.
Moderate aerobic exercise reduces resting heart rate and improves endothelial function, lowering the risk of cardiovascular disease.
Curd is a probiotic-rich food safe to eat at night. It does not induce viral respiratory infections. The gut microbiome benefits regardless of the time.
FSSAI has confirmed 'plastic rice' is physically impossible to manufacture at the claimed cost. Rice grains are starch-based and undergo Maillard reaction when burnt.
While milk adulteration occurs, branded pasteurised milk from FSSAI-licensed dairies meets safety standards. The claim that all milk contains dangerous urea levels is false.
Giloy is an immunomodulator, but no peer-reviewed clinical trial has proven it cures COVID-19. It acts via macrophage activation but does not directly neutralize SARS-CoV-2.
Kadha provides symptomatic relief due to anti-inflammatory properties of ginger and tulsi. It does not replace antipyretics to lower body temperature via the hypothalamus.
Curcumin has poor bioavailability. While it shows apoptotic effects on cancer cells in vitro, no human clinical trial has proven dietary turmeric cures systemic cancer.
Neem extracts show hypoglycaemic effects in animal models by increasing peripheral glucose uptake. However, it cannot replace insulin or metformin therapy safely.
Drinking water while standing does not cause arthritis. Joint synovial fluid is not affected by gastric fluid dynamics. Water reaches the stomach regardless of posture.
Weight gain is governed by total caloric surplus (thermodynamics), not meal timing. The basal metabolic rate does not abruptly decrease simply because it is 7pm.
Ashwagandha acts as an adaptogen, significantly reducing serum cortisol levels and modulating the HPA axis to alleviate self-reported chronic stress.
The liver processes toxins via cytochrome P450 enzymes. Lemon water provides ascorbic acid but does not flush toxins or alter hepatic detoxification pathways.
Cow urine contains nitrogenous waste (urea, creatinine). No clinical evidence supports its use against malignant neoplasms, and raw consumption risks zoonotic infection.
Mobile phones emit non-ionizing radiofrequency radiation, which lacks the quantum energy required to break DNA bonds or cause oncogenic mutations.
The dermal layers of the feet cannot absorb large organic molecules from onions, nor excrete blood-borne viral pathogens or toxins out of the body.
Tulsi (Ocimum sanctum) contains eugenol with antimicrobial effects. While beneficial, it is not a panacea and cannot cure arbitrary systemic diseases.
source: Journal of Ayurveda and Integrative Medicine

scientific_truth: Double-blind studies show no link between dietary sucrose and ADHD symptoms. The perceived hyperactivity is attributed to parent expectation bias.
The sound is caused by the sudden collapse of nitrogen gas cavitation bubbles in synovial fluid, which does not damage cartilage or cause osteoarthritis.
While high in saturated fat, ghee contains conjugated linoleic acid. Moderate consumption does not inherently cause atherosclerosis if total caloric intake is managed.
Raw papaya contains latex and papain, which can stimulate uterine prostaglandin production. However, fully ripe papaya is generally safe during pregnancy.
Cold water does not solidify fats or halt enzymatic breakdown. The stomach's thermal regulation quickly equalizes liquid temperature to 37°C.
Ascorbic acid megadoses (>1g/day) do not prevent viral rhinoviruses in the general population, and excess is excreted via renal filtration.
SARS-CoV-2 is an RNA virus transmitted via respiratory droplets. Electromagnetic radio waves (5G) cannot carry or synthesize biological pathogens.
Sodium hypochlorite (bleach) causes severe mucosal saponification and chemical burns in the esophagus. It does not selectively target intracellular viruses.
Non-haeme iron from spinach prevents mild deficiency, but clinical anaemia requires concentrated ferrous sulphate supplements due to low intestinal absorption rates (~5%).
There is no clinical evidence that medium-chain triglycerides (MCTs) in coconut oil alter amyloid-beta plaque formation or reverse neurodegeneration.
Vitiligo is an autoimmune condition causing localized melanocyte destruction. No biochemical interaction between fish protein and dairy triggers this localized depigmentation.
Copper surfaces exhibit the oligodynamic effect, degrading bacterial cell membranes. While it purifies water slightly, it does not cure systemic human diseases.
Type 1 diabetes is an autoimmune destruction of pancreatic beta cells. While yoga improves insulin sensitivity, it cannot regenerate beta cells or replace exogenous insulin.
Jaggery consists primarily of sucrose and has a high glycaemic index (~84), causing rapid postprandial glucose spikes identical to refined sugar.
Urine is a renal ultrafiltrate consisting of waste metabolites. Ingestion forces the kidneys to re-filter concentrated urea, offering no therapeutic mechanism.
ABO blood group antigens on erythrocyte surfaces do not biochemically interact with dietary lectins in a way that dictates overall metabolic health or disease risk.
Dietary aluminium is poorly absorbed by the gastrointestinal tract and efficiently excreted by healthy kidneys. It is not the causal agent of amyloid plaques.
Ajwain contains thymol, which acts as a carminative and antispasmodic, relaxing gastrointestinal smooth muscle to relieve acute bloating and dyspepsia.
While UV ambient light slowly converts bilirubin to water-soluble isomers, clinical phototherapy uses concentrated 460nm blue light for rapid, controlled hepatic bypass.
Hepatic biosynthesis downregulates internal cholesterol production when dietary intake increases. For most individuals, eggs minimally impact serum LDL cholesterol.
Citric acid from sour foods actually binds urinary calcium, forming a soluble complex that prevents the crystallization of calcium oxalate renal calculi.
Calcium from milk supports osteoblast activity slowly. Curcumin offers mild analgesia. However, it cannot mechanically align or rapidly accelerate bone union.
Fenugreek seeds contain galactomannan soluble fibre, which delays gastric emptying and slows intestinal carbohydrate absorption, mitigating postprandial glucose spikes.
Gluten-induced mucosal enteropathy (increased intestinal permeability) occurs only in individuals with Coeliac disease or NCGS (~1%), not the general population.

claim_subject: aloe vera juice chronic skin disease
scientific_truth: While aloe mucilage has topical anti-inflammatory properties, oral ingestion does not systemically cure autoimmune dermatoses like psoriasis or severe eczema.
Dietary glutamate does not cross the intact blood-brain barrier. Monosodium glutamate is metabolized by intestinal enterocytes and is generally recognized as safe.
Swishing lipids (oil pulling) mechanically saponifies oral biofilms, reducing gingivitis. It has no mechanism to draw out vascular toxins or cure heart disease.
Rice (rich in methionine) and lentils (rich in lysine) provide complementary amino acid profiles, forming a highly bioavailable complete protein source.
Microwaves use non-ionizing radiofrequency to agitate water molecules via dielectric heating. They do not alter molecular structures to form carcinogenic compounds.
Optimal community water fluoridation (0.7 ppm) prevents dental caries via enamel remineralization. High-quality epidemiological studies show no neurodevelopmental impact.
Oral activated charcoal adsorbs intragastric toxins. It cannot cross the intestinal mucosa to bind intramuscular vaccine components in the bloodstream.
Polyphenols (tannins) in black tea strongly chelate non-haeme iron in the gut lumen, forming insoluble complexes that significantly inhibit intestinal iron absorption.
Phytoestrogens (isoflavones) in soy bind very weakly to mammalian estrogen receptors. Clinical meta-analyses show soy does not alter bioavailable testosterone in men.
